name: Clay Layton
role: Horse thief, partner of Henry Scott
bio: Clay Layton and Henry Scott were arrested near Miles City in August 1884 for stealing four horses from Archie Morton of South Heart, and escaped from the Dickinson jail that September. He was rearrested at Buffalo Gap in 1886 and sentenced at Mandan to five years and eight months in the Bismarck penitentiary.
